title: NAV IR 3 FAULT

actions.say: Inertial reference 3 is the backup unit. Confirm both onside inertial references remain normal.
Leave both attitude and heading selectors in the normal position.
Cross-check attitude and heading against the standby instruments.

status: Status. Inertial reference 3 lost; it was the standby unit only.
Both pilots' displays remain on their normal inertial references, with no switching required.
No autopilot limitation; monitor the remaining inertial references.
